verdicts.quote: "To get started, message @BotFather on Telegram to register your bot and receive its authentication token."
verdicts.reason: The Bot API’s standard auth is the bot token issued by @BotFather; this is the primary method a multi-tenant toolkit would use. ([core.telegram.org](https://core.telegram.org/bots/?utm_source=openai))

verdicts.quote: "We welcome all developers to use our API and source code to create Telegram-like messaging applications on our platform free of charge."
verdicts.reason: Bot tokens are issued self‑serve via @BotFather; MTProto api_id/api_hash are issued self‑serve at my.telegram.org, so working credentials are available without payment. ([core.telegram.org](https://core.telegram.org/api/obtaining_api_id?source=post_page---------------------------&utm_source=openai))

verdicts.quote: "Bots can send a wide variety of content privately within a group, including: Media & Expressions: Photos, videos, animations, audio files, voice messages, and stickers. Utility & Location: Documents, contacts, locations, and venues."
verdicts.reason: The docs enumerate many capabilities (rich media, payments, inline/guest mode, business bots, mini apps), indicating a broad API surface. ([core.telegram.org](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features?utm_source=openai))

verdicts.quote: No vendor documentation found referencing an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.
verdicts.reason: I could not find any mention of an official or vendor‑maintained MCP server on core.telegram.org or Telegram’s official GitHub; community servers exist but are not primary vendor sources. ([core.telegram.org](https://core.telegram.org/bots/?utm_source=openai))

verdicts.quote: "By default, all bots are able to broadcast up to 30 messages per second. Developers can increase this limit by enabling Paid Broadcasts in @BotFather."
verdicts.reason: Buildable today: self‑serve creds and comprehensive docs. Caveats: rate limits (30 msg/s by default) and group Privacy Mode limiting what messages a bot sees by default. ([core.telegram.org](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api?utm_source=openai))
